properties.name: v-model
properties.description: Binding data with v-model (Array of items to render in the tree)

properties.name: checkbox
properties.description: Whether to use a checkbox in front of each item.

properties.name: nodeLabel
properties.description: This property customizes the Label value to be displayed in the item. It can be used in the form of an Object or Function with a field list and a saparator. By default, treeInfo.name is displayed.

properties.name: labelAction
properties.description: Whether to display the edit or delete button on the right side of the item.

properties.name: inlineEdit
properties.description: When the labelAction property is true, the modify button that is displayed allows you to modify the item value.

properties.name: rules
properties.description: When the inlineEdit property is true, you can set a rule for validating values ​​that are entered. This is the same as entering Rule for Validation of ur-text-field.

properties.name: msgExpandAll
properties.description: Message for Button that locates in the upper left, "Expand All".

properties.name: msgCollapseAll
properties.description: Message for Button that locates in the upper left, "Collapse All".

properties.name: hierarchicalCheck
properties.description: When the checkbox of the parent node is clicked, the checkbox of the child node is also checked.

properties.name: nodeMoveValid
properties.description: When a node is dragged, validation is executed to determine whether the drag is successful or not according to the return.

events.name: add-button
events.description: Event fires when you click the Add button at the top of the tree.

events.name: delete-button
events.description: Clicking the Add button at the top of the tree will trigger an event with the currently selected node information as a parameter.

events.name: edit-button
events.description: Clicking the Edit button at the top of the tree will trigger an event with the currently selected node information as a parameter.

events.name: select-node
events.description: Event fires when the selected node is changed.

events.name: move-node
events.description: When dragging and dropping a node, an event is triggered using the node information as a parameter.

events.name: input
events.description: When the input value is changed, an event is triggered with the changed value as a parameter.

events.name: checkNode
events.description: When the input value is changed, an event is triggered with the changed value as a parameter.
